# temps_webhook_event_types (Data Source)

Lists the events a `temps_webhook` can subscribe to. Needs the `webhooks:read` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "temps_webhook_event_types" "all" {}

# Subscribe to every deployment event.
resource "temps_webhook" "all_deployments" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  url        = "https://hooks.example.com/temps"
  events     = [for e, c in data.temps_webhook_event_types.all.categories : e if c == "Deployment"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `categories` (Map of String) Event type name to its category, for example `Deployment`.
- `event_types` (List of String) Event type names, for example `deployment.succeeded`.
- `id` (String) Always `webhook_event_types`.
